Coastal survey report

Survey crews mapped the coast after winter storms changed the shoreline at six monitoring sites. Their report compares the latest measurements with records collected over the last decade.

The team explains how tide timing affects each reading and identifies areas where the public access route remains open. The complete methods and station notes are included in the report.
